payload.summary: Planned a strict v2 semantic-query boundary over RI02 immutable indexes. Independent review tightened non-main selection, principal-bound scope authorization, dynamic readiness, dependency packaging, contract truth tables, and observability before implementation.

decisions.title: Exact immutable selection
decisions.rationale: Main uses the guarded canonical pointer; non-main requests require exact index_id and full identity validation.

decisions.title: Principal-bound scope ceiling
decisions.rationale: Caller filters only narrow server-owned repository and namespace grants; unresolved work-package provenance fails closed.

decisions.title: Loop-owned dynamic runtime
decisions.rationale: HTTP and direct MCP own separate bounded runtimes with TTL, backoff, invalidation, and shutdown cancellation.

decisions.title: Declared query package dependency
decisions.rationale: Coordinator local and production installs use one supported code-search-pkg and asyncpg boundary instead of Docker-only source copying.

next_steps: Implement contract tests first, then the shared package/query boundary.
Keep external Postgres and provider tests resource-gated but preserve explicit degraded evidence.
